common.validity: SIM clock mode: the times of the executor, the bridge wrapper and the checks are SIM times, so an RTF below 1 does not make a run invalid (acceptance amendment 61). The RTF of every judged step is reported. A judged step with a 5 s window RTF below 0.5 is a host failure: recorded, not judged, and run once more on a fresh stack; twice is reported as not judged
common.host: the host-load check of STACK_OPERATIONS_KO.md section 2 is recorded before each session (waiting at most 60 s); the stall probe is not run

A.check: steering.exec_checks follow --run <name> --out /runs/follow (one_press: Start, Arm, heartbeats, one go)
A.passed: every judged run passes every criterion of steer_follow_gsim_v1 and at least three of four slots are judged

W.check: the same follow check in the wall clock mode, nominal_1 then lateral_p040 on one stack
W.note: load record of the vehicle code path (acceptance amendment 61); reported with the RTF and the executor loop times

B.check: the SIM dashboard in Chrome (playwright) as an operator uses it; services sim, steer, recorder, dashboard, executor; scene w1_force; SIM clock

items.name: prepare
items.rule: the auto panel offers 준비; pressing it (and Arm if offered) reaches 자율 주행 시작 within 16 s

items.name: one_press_running
items.rule: one press -> 주행 중 within 10 s and the vehicle moves (emulator speed > 0.05 m/s)

items.name: heartbeat
items.rule: largest gap of the last 20 heartbeats while visible < 0.50 s

items.name: tab_hidden_link_lost
items.rule: tab hidden -> run_state paused, stop_reason OPERATOR_LINK_LOST 2.0 s after hiding, no heartbeat after hiding, the vehicle below 0.05 m/s 4 s after hiding, visible again -> 다시 출발 and still paused

items.name: screen_stop_while_running
items.rule: a new run, one press, about 6 s of driving (> 0.05 m/s), the status-bar STOP -> stop_detail operator_stop (OPERATOR_OR_BACKSTOP), below 0.05 m/s 3 s later and 6 s later

items.name: restart_after_stop
items.rule: after that STOP: latch acknowledged, a new run prepared, one press -> the vehicle drives again (> 0.05 m/s within 6 s), the STOP stops it again (operator_stop, below 0.05 m/s 3 s later)

items.name: live_map
items.rule: on /map, 그리기 시작, 20 s later /api/live/map scan_count > 0 and cell_count > 0

C.check: steering.exec_checks safety --out /runs/safety --reset-pose --still-speed 0.05 (scene w1_force, one_press, SIM clock)
C.criteria: SIM_ACCEPTANCE_KO.md A17 per script as coded in exec_checks, with amendment 60 (operator link lost -> drive 0 <= operator_timeout_s + 1 tick) and amendment 62 (on W1 the vehicle is still below 0.05 m/s truth: the start area slopes about 1.6 deg and the plant creeps 0.016-0.03 m/s with drive 0); deadman_release is not applicable to one_press
C.passed: every script passes; a script that stops with an error (for example a refused go) fails

E.criteria: the executor criteria of steer_follow_gsim_final_v1 part E (the restore is read after the status shows it, amendment 2 of stage 2 now in the check); the plant speed ratio is reported

F.check: the user's local commands as they are (the local tool folder tools/local_env outside the repository): python -B sim_stack.py start --no-browser (image wf6, SIM clock by default), 150 s, then 3 times: python -B sim_auto.py start; python -B sim_auto.py reset; 20 s
F.criteria: each run ends at the row end: the executor's run_end of that run has end_reason row_end (the screen line of sim_auto shows the end); distance and duration are reported
F.passed: 3 of 3 runs end at the row end

amendments.written: after parts A, W, B, C, E (09:29-10:31 UTC), before B is run again and before F

(i) is judged again on the same record from the recorded values; (ii) cannot be judged from the record. B is run once more on a fresh stack with the script fixed (speeds: None only counts as missing; heartbeat times: the request start times of the browser). The verdict of B is attempt 2; attempt 1 is kept
amendments.C: evaluation defect of second_screen_and_cli: exec_checks still expected the end reason bridge_error or bridge_latched, against acceptance amendment 34 (registered before this registration: a STOP of another client that reaches the bridge first ends the run as operator_stop). The same record is judged again with operator_stop expected; exec_checks is fixed for later runs. Every other script as recorded
